prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a modern printer with a translucent blue paper tray, holding a freshly printed white sheet of paper. The paper features bold, black geometric patterns at the top, followed by the stylized text "mmmh! PRESENTA: DATE UN LIKE" in a clean, sans-serif font, with a solid black heart icon beneath the words. The background is softly blurred in a warm, pastel pink hue, creating a gentle contrast with the cool blue and white tones of the printer and paper. The lighting is soft and even, with minimal shadows, emphasizing the crispness of the printed text and the smooth surfaces of the printer. The composition is tight and focused, with the camera angled slightly above and to the side, drawing attention to the message on the paper and the tactile details of the printer tray. The overall style is clean, modern, and inviting, with a hint of playful energy suggested by the color palette and graphic design elements.
